mapper.select: SELECT up.id AS id, up.version AS version, up.lastUpdatedDate AS lastUpdatedDate, up.status AS status, p.id AS perm_id, p.uid AS perm_uid, p.code AS perm_code, p.description AS perm_description, p.version AS perm_version, p.type AS perm_type, p.lastUpdatedDate AS perm_lastUpdatedDate FROM ${table_prefix_identity}userPermission up INNER JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}user u ON up.user_uid = u.uid AND u.deletedDate IS NULL AND u.uid = #{uid} RIGHT JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}permission p ON up.permission_uid = p.uid AND up.deletedDate IS NULL WHERE up.deletedDate IS NULL ORDER BY up.lastUpdatedDate DESC

SELECT ur.id AS id, ur.version AS version, r.id AS role_id, r.uid AS role_uid, r.code AS role_code, r.description AS role_description, r.version AS role_version, CASE WHEN ur.user_uid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS enabled FROM ${table_prefix_identity}userRole ur INNER JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}user u ON ur.user_uid = u.uid AND u.deletedDate IS NULL AND u.uid = #{uid} RIGHT JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}role r ON ur.role_uid = r.uid AND ur.deletedDate IS NULL WHERE ur.deletedDate IS NULL

SELECT rp.permission_uid AS permissionUid, r.code AS roleCode FROM ${table_prefix_identity}rolePermission rp INNER JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}role r ON rp.role_uid = r.uid WHERE rp.deletedDate IS NULL AND r.id IN
#{roleId}

SELECT u.uid AS uid, u.userName AS userName FROM ${table_prefix_identity}user u WHERE u.uid IN
#{uid}
